_notes: Manifest of every ad campaign/reservation managed by admin/index.html — one
entry here per data/ads/campaigns/<id>.json file. Unlike config/orgs/, this
directory IS mirrored (it lives under data/, which mirror-signal.yml and
mirror-intel.yml both copy in full) because this is the actual creative
content the public site renders — intel.html reads exactly this file to
decide which sponsored slides to show, without ever fetching config/
(deliberately excluded from every mirror, and mirrored copies of intel.html
are meant to be fully self-contained — see that file's own header comment).
That self-containment is why each campaign carries its own org_snapshot
(id/status/exp) instead of intel.html cross-referencing config/orgs/ at
render time — the snapshot is taken by admin/index.html whenever a
campaign is generated/regenerated there, so it can go stale if the org's
status or expiry changes afterward without the campaign being
regenerated. The admin page surfaces that staleness and offers a
one-click resync; nothing on the live site ever notices or corrects it
on its own. This is the same snapshot-not-live-query tradeoff every other
page on this site already makes (everything here is periodically
regenerated JSON, not a live database).
Each entry carries enough to decide LIVE/not-live without fetching the
full campaign file (which also holds the base64 logo/image data URIs —
no reason to download those for a campaign that isn't going to render).
Shape: { id, org_id, tier, active, reservation_mode, start_date, end_date,
org_snapshot: { status, exp } }. tier is standard | pro | premium and
sets rotation weight/positioning (see AD_TIER_WEIGHT in intel.html) —
higher tiers are sorted earlier in the rotation and so land in more of
the fixed ad slots (every AD_INSERT_INTERVAL-th digest slide) as the
cycle repeats. reservation_mode is "persistent" (no schedule — runs
until deactivated) or "campaign" (bounded by start_date/end_date,
inclusive, both YYYY-MM-DD).
A campaign is LIVE only when ALL of: active === true, org_snapshot.status
=== "active", org_snapshot.exp is null or in the future, and either
reservation_mode is "persistent" or today falls within
[start_date, end_date]. See isLive() in admin/index.html and intel.html —
deliberately duplicated rather than shared, matching this site's
established per-page self-containment convention (escapeHtml,
wireDragToDismiss, etc. are all duplicated the same way).
Empty until a campaign is created via admin/index.html and its files
downloaded + committed here — until then intel.html's ad rotation is
simply empty (no sponsored slides), which is the correct, honest
behavior for a fresh clone rather than showing placeholder ad content.
